Q56. To what extent are you concerned with each of the following scenarios?
Sample size: n = 939 [China]; 1,306 [Germany]; 882 [India]; 637 [Japan]; 906 [Republic of Korea]; 5,028 [Southeast Asia]; 1,314 [UK]; 937 [US]
More than three quarters of surveyed consumers in India and China believe the addition of artificial  
intelligence in vehicle systems is beneficial. On the other hand, a quarter of surveyed consumers in  
Germany, the United States, and the United Kingdom remain skeptical about the technology.
